quarterly_data.signal: CLARITY-Gastric01 release detail beyond the call: the trial enrolled patients with CLDN18.2 expression on at least 25% of tumour cells at any staining intensity, which the company says represents approximately 60% of patients in this setting (an estimated 60% of gastric/GEJ cancers express CLDN18.2 in 25% or more of tumour cells), with roughly 183,500 patients a year in the US, EU, China and Japan treated in the 2nd and later-line setting for CLDN18.2-positive, non-HER2-positive gastric/GEJ cancers. Sone-Ve has Orphan Drug Designation from the US FDA and the European Commission for gastric and GEJ cancers and Breakthrough Designation in China for 2nd-line gastric cancer; it was well tolerated with no new safety signals, and the data will be shared with global regulatory authorities. The trial runs in 175 centres across 19 countries with 2.2 mg/kg every three weeks as the recommended Phase III dose, and its efficacy analyses will also be the basis to evaluate the clinical performance of the Ventana SP455 assay for identifying CLDN18.2-expressing patients (companion diagnostic). Sone-Ve (MMAE payload) was licensed globally from KYM Biosciences in March 2023; AstraZeneca calls CLARITY-Gastric01 the first Phase III trial to show an OS benefit with an anti-CLDN18.2 ADC in this setting (company claim).
